tasks.title: Damp / stained appearance
tasks.scope: MBDD publisher leakage boxes were trained as visible stain appearance; measured accuracy fails. The 47 positive/51 other-defect-negative TEST photos are not independent healthy-wall validation or moisture measurements.
tasks.guidance: Show a sharp, evenly lit close-up and an intact neighbouring surface. Record the visible appearance and confirm it by inspection.
tasks.guidanceAr: أظهر لقطة قريبة واضحة بإضاءة متجانسة مع جزء سليم مجاور. وثّق المظهر المرئي وتحقق منه بالفحص.

tasks.title: Mold-like appearance
tasks.scope: Public PHELE Mold labels were trained, but only 3 Mold-positive TEST photos exist, recall is poor, and physical sites are unknown. Appearance is not humidity or fungal diagnosis.

tasks.title: Expected bolt
tasks.scope: SDNET combines missing bolt/nut appearance rather than separate bolt absence. An installation finding also needs an expected layout and positively visible empty seat; no qualified model supplies those prerequisites.
tasks.guidance: Show the whole connection, then its visible bolt and nut seats. Compare with the approved expected layout; appearance does not measure torque or anchorage.
tasks.guidanceAr: أظهر الوصلة كاملة ثم مواضع المسامير والصواميل المرئية. قارن بالمخطط المعتمد؛ المظهر لا يقيس العزم أو كفاءة التثبيت.

tasks.title: Expected nut
tasks.scope: SDNET combines missing bolt/nut appearance rather than separate nut absence. An expected layout and positively visible empty seat are required; detector silence never proves a missing nut.
tasks.guidance: Show the whole connection, then its visible bolt and nut seats. Compare with the approved expected layout; appearance does not measure torque or anchorage.
tasks.guidanceAr: أظهر الوصلة كاملة ثم مواضع المسامير والصواميل المرئية. قارن بالمخطط المعتمد؛ المظهر لا يقيس العزم أو كفاءة التثبيت.

tasks.scope: SDNET publisher Loosen connections were trained for research; incomplete labels, unknown sites and failed release evidence remain. Visible appearance does not measure torque, embedment or anchorage strength.
tasks.guidance: Show the whole connection, then its visible bolt and nut seats. Compare with the approved expected layout; appearance does not measure torque or anchorage.

tasks.scope: Although advertised in metadata, the acquired SDNET annotation taxonomy has no corrosion class. No accepted steel-connection corrosion detector is established in this family.
tasks.guidance: Show the whole connection, then its visible bolt and nut seats. Compare with the approved expected layout; appearance does not measure torque or anchorage.

tasks.title: Joint width
tasks.scope: Only experimental parallel-edge spacing geometry is implemented. It is not a grout classifier; installed-floor data with independently measured widths is missing, so millimetre results and fault decisions are unqualified.
tasks.guidance: Photograph the joint and surrounding tiles. Record the specified width/tolerance and a physical measurement; judge against the approved installation detail.
tasks.guidanceAr: صوّر الفاصل والبلاط المحيط. سجّل العرض والسماحية المحددين وقياساً فعلياً، ثم راجع التفصيل المعتمد.
